title: Nexus ListCharacterMemoryFragmentsQuery
description: Query for GET /v1/daemon/characters/{character_id}/memory/fragments. `binding_id` selects one active binding-local scope; omitted selects the shared Character scope.

limit.description: Page size; defaults to 50, clamped to 1..=100.

cursor.description: Opaque offset cursor from a previous page's `pagination.next_cursor`.
